title: Velvety Rich Australian Fish Wrap
description: A halal-friendly Australian dish featuring fatty fish, double cream, and pandan leaf wrap, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Rinse the barramundi fillets under cold water, then pat them dry with paper towels.
Season the fish with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat, then sear the fish for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the fish to an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
In a small bowl, mix together the double cream, lemon juice, and minced garlic.
To assemble the wraps, lay a pandan leaf flat on a work surface, then place a piece of fish in the center of the leaf.
Spoon some of the cream mixture over the fish, then fold the pandan leaf over the filling to form a wrap.
Serve the wraps immediately, garnished with additional pandan leaves if desired.
